events.what_it_is: A two-day Reese's and The Nitro Bar truck pop-up debuting the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte with Halloween-themed giveaways and treats.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised each day, each with a recipe card and Reese's Pumpkins. The first 100 people in line each day can also receive a limited-edition koozie, with additional Reese's treats while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no advance RSVP requirement published. Promotional inventory is while supplies last. Current listings agree on an 11 AM start on September 14 and 15, but published closing times conflict; the event copy itself says it runs until supplies run out.
events.practical_notes: Monday, September 14 and Tuesday, September 15 at Astor Place. Arrive early if you want the limited koozie or latte because the activation can end when supplies are exhausted.

events.event_name: Mary Kay Beauty Is More Beautiful Shared Experience
events.address: Gansevoort Plaza, 38 Gansevoort St, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: A one-day public Mary Kay beauty activation built around an oversized vanity, beauty touch-ups, product discovery and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: Mary Kay advertises 10,000 free makeup and skin-care products to give away during the activation.
events.caveats: The official Mary Kay U.S. Eventbrite page offers tickets and does not state host approval. Secondary current listings also describe the activation as free and open to the public. Giveaway inventory is finite and not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–7 PM at Gansevoort Plaza. Use the Mary Kay U.S. Eventbrite page for the direct registration path.

events.event_name: eos × NYLON Dewy Lip Shine Pop-Up Truck
events.what_it_is: A one-day NYFW pop-up truck for eos Dewy Lip Shine with product sampling, sweet treats and photo moments.
events.what_is_free: NYLON's current event email advertises a free Dewy Lip Shine, ice pops and other treats while supplies last. The first 50 guests are advertised to receive a jelly bag containing the full Dewy Lip Shine collection.
events.caveats: Current listings describe the event as open to the public with no RSVP requirement. The first-50 jelly bags and all samples/treats are first-come, first-served while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Tuesday, September 15 from 12–5 PM at 575 Broadway in SoHo. Arrive near opening if you want the first-50 full-collection jelly bag.
